Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the PRIDE metadata and the 'Chromatographic purification' section specifically focuses on the interactomes of AP2 proteins using affinity purification (anti-Flag M2 gel). While the broader paper discusses whole-cell proteomes of different parasite stages, the specific MS project PXD042658 is an affinity-purified complex study. Human system is present as the parasites were grown in HFF (human fibroblast) monolayers.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a conditional knockdown (mAID) system induced by IAA to trigger a developmental switch from tachyzoites to merozoites. The proteomics analysis focuses on the global proteome changes across different timepoints of induction and the specific interactomes of the AP2 proteins.
